rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a Day 5 expanded blastocyst consistent with 3AB, including compact ICM, looser TE, and thinning zona; minor uncertainty from image-specific details like exact location of structures and added mention of a polar body/fragment.
Strong integration of age, ovarian response, AMH/FSH, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, cycle history, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with a clear link from embryo grade and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include somewhat speculative penalties for stress and some optimistic cumulative/live birth framing.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading and general IVF prognostic factors, but several recommendations (ERA without repeated failure, aspirin, sildenafil, G-CSF, PRP, growth hormone, routine PGT-A at age 32) are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
Provides concrete next steps for transfer and future planning, including endometrial reassessment and lifestyle/stress interventions; slightly reduced by inclusion of multiple low-evidence adjuncts.
